title: Slovakian Smoked Long Bean Fritters
description: A traditional Slovakian dish made with smoked long beans, perfect for a snack or side. These crispy fritters are easy to make and delicious to eat.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the long beans, smoked paprika, flour, bake soda, eggs, vanilla sugar, salt, and bake powder.
Mix well until a thick batter forms.
Gradually add in the water and mix until the batter reaches the desired consistency.
Heat the oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat.
Using a spoon, drop small amounts of the batter into the hot oil.
Fry the fritters until they are golden brown and crispy.
Remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the fritters hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
